Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
Cry Wolf : If the action to recruit this ally is blocked, the acting
anarch goes to torpor.

Summoning superior : +1 stealth action. [PRE] Search your library for an
ally. This vampire recruits that ally (he or she must meet the
requirements, if any, of the ally). Pay cost as normal. Shuffle your
library afterward.

When the Summoning is played, must it be announced that the target is
the Cry Wolf, and if it is blocked will the recruiter go to torpor ?

T.I.A.

Orpheus

IANLSJ but...

What you are probably thinking of is that all actions must be fully
declared when announced. For example "I Minion Tap Anson for 5" and not
"I Minion Tap" or even "I Minion Tap Anson". Or more to the point,
"Carlotta attempts to exchange this lousy Chainsaw from my hand with
that Minion Tap in my ash heap".

However, in the case of "The Summoning", the action when fully declared
sounds like, "Gideon Fontaine plays The Summoning to search for an ally
or retainer." The fully declared action is the **search** and doesn't
require a card name.

> Has it changed recently, or I've grown senile already? :-)

Hmm. How best to break this to you? Ah, yes...

"Are you a big fan of prunes by any chance?"

-Robert

> requires you to announce the card. But I don't see this in the
> official rulings, only this (marked as errata now):
>
> If an effect causes you to search your library or crypt, shuffle that
> deck afterward. [LSJ 20040518]
>
> Has it changed recently, or I've grown senile already? :-)

It hasn't changed, recently or otherwise.

You cannot search/examine your library beforehand.

Search/look at/examine is as far as it'll go at announcement.
Search/look at/examine is effectively a veil for the rest of the action
terms.

Similarly, Le Dinh Tho doesn't have to announce which card he'll be
discarding when the action is announced (even if Revelations is in
play).
